## Teaching

Teaching assistant, Faculty of Economics and Business, Universitas Indonesia,
since February 2024 — the econometrics sequence across the doctoral, master's,
and public policy programmes. Permanent public procurement instructor for the
Government of North Sulawesi since 2023. [Full list →](teaching.qmd)

## Professional experience

Civil servant, Provincial Civil Service Agency (BKD), Provincial Government of
North Sulawesi, since 2015; on study leave (PNS tugas belajar) for doctoral
study since 2023. Earlier roles include head of the provincial sub-division for
procurement assistance and technical guidance, commitment-making official,
member of the procurement selection working group, procurement strategy analyst,
and asset management officer. [Full history →](professional.qmd)

## Public procurement

Competency assessor for the Professional Certification Body of the National
Public Procurement Agency (LKPP) since 2025; procurement advisor and contract support
team member since 2020; certified facilitator since 2018. Certified mediator
under the Supreme Court of the Republic of Indonesia.
[Full profile →](procurement/index.qmd)

## Professional certifications

Competency Assessor — Public Procurement (LKPP) &middot; Public Procurement
Competency Facilitator, Levels 1–4 (LKPP) &middot; Advanced Public Procurement
Facilitator (LKPP) &middot; Public Procurement Advisor (LKPP) &middot; Certified
Mediator (Supreme Court of Indonesia) &middot; Certificate Professional in Public
Procurement (World Bank) &middot; Social and Behavioral Research (CITI Program).

## Professional service

**Refereeing.** Reviewer, [*Jurnal Kebijakan Ekonomi*](https://scholarhub.ui.ac.id/jke/reviewers.html),
Faculty of Economics and Business, Universitas Indonesia.

**Associations.** [Secretary, North Sulawesi chapter](https://sulut.iapi-indonesia.org/profil-dpd/),

## Skills

**Technical.** Advanced econometrics, spatial econometrics, causal inference,
geospatial data analysis (GIS).

**Software.** Stata, R, Python, LaTeX, QGIS.

**Languages.** Indonesian (native), English (professional working proficiency).
